metadata.description: Agent skills that ship with the evidence they work: prompts, assertions and before/after scores.

plugins.name: pr-todo
plugins.description: Report every open pull request a developer must act on in a GitHub organization — review requested, authored or assigned — as a raw table with clickable links, merge status, the concrete reason each PR is stuck, and age.

plugins.name: sentry-triage
plugins.description: Rank the unresolved Sentry issues of a project by impact — deterministic severity score, trend, innermost in-app frame, failure origin, root-cause clusters — then decide what to fix first by severity and complexity.

plugins.name: pr-guardian
plugins.description: Watch one pushed branch until its pull request is green, merged or blocked: rebase on the default branch, fix what CI and the reviewers report, one guardian per branch with a write lock against the human, orphan re-adoption at session start, and --dry-run for the plan without any push.
